reading.zh: 先是构造与 worker 控制，再是单个操作如何被分发（受限视图加 Python 或 VScript 执行），随后是队列驱动的运行，最后是 submit/run/cancel 接口。
reading.en: Construction and worker control, then how one operation is dispatched (scoped view plus Python or VScript execution), then queue-driven runs, and finally the submit/run/cancel surface.
